hero.statementLead: Servers that stay up, and teams that
hero.intro: I configure Minecraft networks, plugins and permissions, then build the Discord and the staff structure around them. Been doing this since 2019, and the handover matters as much as the build.

disciplines.label: What I do
disciplines.title: Three sides of the same job.
disciplines.lede: Most servers I get called into aren't broken because of bad plugins. They're broken because nobody ever wrote down how any of it works.

items.title: Servers and plugins
items.body: Paper and Purpur tuning, Velocity proxies, permission trees, economies and custom content. Most of the work is getting twenty plugins to stop fighting over the same events.

items.title: Discord communities
items.body: Channel structure, roles, onboarding and tickets, with enough automation that moderating stops being somebody's second job.

items.title: Staff and teams
items.body: Hiring, training, rotas and escalation. Teams that can make a call at three in the morning without waiting for an owner to wake up.

closing.title: Tell me what's breaking.
closing.body: Send over what you're running and what keeps going wrong with it. If I'm not the right person for the job, I'll say so.
